name: sendMessage
shortDescription: Sends a secure message between a patient and their assigned doctor, ensuring proper linkage and logging.
description:
Overview

This function facilitates secure and auditable communication between a patient and their assigned doctor. It verifies the sender and receiver relationship, creates a new Message record, and logs the communication event.

Intended use

Called by the patient or doctor UI when sending a message. Parameters include senderId, receiverId, content, and conversationId. It ensures that only authorized parties can communicate.

Logic

  1. Validate that the senderId and receiverId correspond to a valid patient-doctor relationship or that the sender is an admin.
  2. Create a new Message record using ctx.data.create, populating senderId, receiverId, content, and conversationId.
  3. Audit-log the message sending event using ctx.audit.log, including sender, receiver, and message content summary.
  4. Return the created Message record.

Entities

  • Message
  • Patient
  • Doctor
  • AuditLog
